slices.focus: Capped loan to brother Logan paired with budget tightening after recognizing combined financial drain
slices.summary: Derek's brother Logan loses another job and needs back rent, prompting a kitchen-table reckoning with Erin. They agree on a single capped loan rather than open-ended rescue, and Derek realizes that renovation overruns and family cash requests have been draining the same financial cushion. He and Erin set limits together — the first time he has not made a solo promise — and he begins trimming discretionary spending on takeout and impulse house purchases to protect monthly cash flow.
